findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A story task’s repair review records a P1 follow-up titled `Not done: The checkout uses the tax formatter`. A later repair makes every checkout fail because that formatter is missing, and the reviewer repeats the finding as a normal-use P0. Although this check no longer marks it as a repair follow-up, `src/forge/noise.py:34` then drops it because the title does not match an approved Done-when sentence. If the earlier blocker is fixed, close can proceed despite the broken checkout. The escalation test exercises fixes, not story tasks.

The same outcome occurs if a P1 follow-up is later reported as a rare P0 and then as a normal-use P0. `src/forge/review.py:1026` includes the rare occurrence’s raw P0 in the settlement ceiling, so lines 1059–1064 carry a `known:` dismissal onto the normal-use P0.
